verdict.rationale: Cline ships an official CLI, installed with `npm install -g cline`, that supports interactive terminal chat sessions and headless automation, with documented usage examples such as `cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"` and piping `git diff` into it. Local model runtimes (Ollama, LM Studio) are also documented, which reinforces the local-execution angle. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the terminal CLI specifically.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal
